checks: d3 >= d2 >= d4 and all of d2,d3,d4,e,h,k,l,m grow monotonically with size
h is within -1..+3 mm of d3 for every row (equal at M8, M10, M24, M72x6)
e < k < m for every row; m/k between 1.14 and 1.25
P values are the ISO 261 coarse pitches (M8 1.25 ... M64 6); M72x6 uses pitch 6 from the designation itself
shape_hint: A forged collar eye bolt: a round ring (eye, outer diameter d3, bore d4, section k) on top of a flat round collar (diameter d2, thickness e) joined to it by a short neck; below the collar a plain threaded shank of length l and diameter d1. Side view: ring on top, collar disc, threaded shank pointing down; total height h from collar bearing face to top of ring.

role_map.h: overall height from bearing face to top of eye
role_map.m: standard dimension m of the eye/neck region (always larger than k; see the standard drawing)

notes: DIN 580 (Sept 2010 series, M8-M72x6 kept; the 2018 edition adds M6, M14, M18, M22, M27, M33, M39, M45, M52, M60, which are dropped here because sources conflict). Sizes M80x6 and M100x6 dropped (h only 2 sources). Dimensions are nominal (tolerances are in the standard). WLL (working load limit) is NOT included: load tables vary by edition (2010 vs 2018) and need the standard. DIN 580 and ISO 3266 forged eye bolts are similar but not identical; the table is DIN 580 only. KS B 1033 (JIS B 1168 style, different dimensions with A/B/C/D/H/L symbols) was not verified. Birkhofer sheet: its row labelled 'm' contains e values (6,6,8,10,...), real m was not listed there. birkhofer l(M24)=35 is an outlier vs 36 from 6 other sources.

NOT counted: h-lift.com (columns only 'A B C D', no header meaning -> role by magnitude)
whole-spec.com (labels D/d/H/L/E/C, KS B 1033, e/k disagree at M36/M48/M56)

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched live (HTTP 200): fasteners.eu, fullerfasteners, fasten.it, ganternorm, h-lift, itafasteners, whole-spec, hlhrapid, trfastenings, fastenerexperts, engineeringtoolbox, wikipedia; parsed transposed/nominal-min-max tables with Python. Matrix 13 rows x 8 dimension cols (d2,d3,d4,e,h,k,l,m) x {fasteners.eu, Fuller, fasten.it 2010+2018, Ganter (<=M36), ITA, whole-spec}: 0 numeric disagreements among fasteners.eu/Fuller/fasten.it/Ganter over ALL sizes incl. the 2018-only ones (checked 25 sizes x 8 cols). Every record cell equals fasteners.eu AND Fuller AND fasten.it (d2,d3,d4,e,k,l,m; h has no fasten.it column) -> 3 non-PDF clusters; M8-M36 additionally Ganter. P checked M8..M64 in 4-5 thread charts (all equal); M72x6 P=6 is part of the designation printed in all 3 DIN sources. Physical: d3=d4+2k exact for all 13 rows; d3>=d2>=d4; h within -1..+3 of d3; all columns monotonic.
problems: h for M42..M72x6: only fasteners.eu + Fuller among the producer's listed web sources (fasten.it has no h column; Ganter stops at M36; Birkhofer/intafast are PDFs). The producer's support counts (4 / 3) included PDFs. h is rescued only by an extra source NOT in record.sources: itafasteners.com table (h M42=147, M48=168, M56=187, M64=208, M72=260; label 'M72' without x6), plus whole-spec (H, M42-M56) and anschlagmittel-online (M42). At M64 and M72x6 h therefore has exactly 3 clusters (fasteners.eu, Fuller, ITA) -> add itafasteners.com to sources or drop h/rows M64,M72x6 (ITA labels d2/d3 swapped relative to DIN but its 'h' header matches).

column m: no source defines it (header symbol only); producer's role text 'neck width / standard dimension m of the eye-neck region' is a guess -> dropped (drawing does not need it). If kept, label must be symbol-only.
k/e roles are validated only by arithmetic (d3=d4+2k) and DIN symbol convention, not by a verbal definition in any source (acceptable, flag only).
h-lift A/B/C/D columns have no meaning in the page (role by magnitude) - producer counted it for d2,d3,d4,l; not needed, cells still have 3 other clusters.
row M72x6 mixes fine-pitch designation with coarse-pitch rows (DIN 580 itself designates M72x6, M80x6, M100x6).
M80x6 / M100x6 rows dropped by producer for h having 2 sources would also reach 3 with ITA (h=298/330) - optional restore; all other columns there have fasteners.eu+Fuller+fasten.it.
